✨ Investment Opportunity in Copperas Cove! ✨ #realestate 
This 2021 duplex is ready to start building your wealth. Perfect for VA buyers who want to live in one side and rent the other—or for investors looking for a turn-key property.

🏡 Each unit: 3 bed | 2 bath
📅 Leased through 2026
💰 Current total rent: $2,825/month
🚫 Tenants cover utilities & landscaping
✨ Granite countertops | No carpet | Privacy fencing

Located in the sought-after Heartwood Park area, this duplex blends modern living with steady income potential.

📍 1818 Castroville Trail, Copperas Cove, TX 76557

📲 Contact Kati Bennett, Realtor® today: 512.285.7724 | kati@i35group.com
